transitions.SCAN_to_WAIT_RETURN: a completed 60-minute window yields one pair-specific direction and causal ATR
transitions.WAIT_RETURN_to_CONFIRM: a preregistered 0.25 ATR adverse pullback is observed and a later completed M5 close resumes in the direction
transitions.CONFIRM_to_ENTER: enter only at the next available M1 executable quote; delayed-entry arm skips a chase
transitions.ENTER_to_MONITOR: freeze decision_id, account mode, units, entry quote, spread/slippage and margin inputs
transitions.MONITOR_to_TAKE_PROFIT: a preregistered hard TP or partial-profit threshold is met at a completed quote
transitions.MONITOR_to_HEDGE: a completed M5 bar reaches a separately reported trigger in {0.25,0.5,1.0,1.5} ATR; order is effective no earlier than the next M1 bar
transitions.HEDGE_to_WAIT_RECOVERY: hedging account holds both legs and reports both; netting account realizes a reduction and cannot label it hedge P/L
transitions.WAIT_RECOVERY_to_BE_UNWIND: original executable P/L is at least BE, or the H5 combined realized hedge offset covers original executable loss including unwind slippage
transitions.any_open_to_TERMINAL_MTM: the replay ends with open inventory marked at final executable bid/ask; no end-of-replay close is generated
transitions.any_to_FORCED_LIQUIDATION_FAILURE: equity is not above broker margin; liquidation is explicit failure, never a successful no-loss exit
transitions.any_to_NOT_EVALUABLE: financing, causal quote, account mode, or joint portfolio margin is missing

causality.hedge_effective_quote: next M1 bar after completed trigger
causality.threshold_selection: every preregistered trigger reported separately; no post-result winner selection

fusion.technical_price_action: provide pair direction, structural break and return confirmation; they do not waive accounting gates
fusion.forecast: optional edge family only when causally archived; missing remains missing
fusion.continuous_thesis: tracks entry-frozen direction versus completed return/reversal evidence
fusion.multidimensional_cube: one cell per independent family, preserving dissent and missing values
fusion.trailing_BE_partial: may request profit/BE unwind only at an executable later quote
fusion.operator_alpha: consumes the fused answer to rotate, wait, manage or skip
